name: model_registry
summary: Read-only lookup interface over studio/models/registry.json. Provides tier resolution (tiny/medium/large/epic), VRAM budgeting, quantization selection. The bridge between the installer (writes) and the token_router (reads).
engine_pattern: stateless dataclass-backed query (ModelCard) over the registry JSON. Loaded lazily; rebuilds by re-reading the file.

inbound_callers: core/lib/token_router.py::ModelRouter (imports ModelRegistry + ModelCard for tier → model resolution)
core/lib/forward_projector.py (transitively — picks CC_TINY_MODEL default from registry)
outbound_calls: std json + pathlib (no subprocess, no network)

guarantees: Deterministic lookup: same registry + same query → same ModelCard, byte-for-byte
No mutation: registry is read-only here; only model_installer writes
Graceful degradation: missing registry returns empty list (router falls back to defaults)
Cross-brand: ollama + huggingface + cloud entries unified under one schema
usage_example:
from model_registry import ModelRegistry
reg = ModelRegistry()
card = reg.find_for_tier('tiny')
print(card.name, card.context_window, card.vram_gb)
